title: Technician filter on the expanded Technician Efficiency chart offers the technicians in its table, including non-billable ones
custom_preconds:
A non-billable, clockable technician enrolled at the active workplace, with clocked time on an invoiced work order dated inside the Technician Efficiency card's current window
A billable technician with clocked time on an invoiced work order in that window
Logged in as a user with dashboard access; active workplace = the seeded workplace

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the dashboard and expand the Technician Efficiency tile
custom_steps_separated.expected: The details panel opens with the Technician Efficiency chart and the technician table, which lists both seeded technicians
The options are the technicians in the table below, including the non-billable technician. All are ticked and the filter reads all technicians

custom_steps_separated.content: Untick the billable technician and close the filter
custom_steps_separated.expected: The filter summary narrows to the remaining selection

custom_steps_separated.content: Reopen the filter and wait for the chart to settle
custom_steps_separated.expected: The same technicians are still offered (the list does not shrink), the billable technician reads unticked, the chart shows a settled state (chart or empty, not an error), and the table lists only the selected technician (the billable technician's row is gone, the non-billable technician's row remains)

custom_steps_separated.content: Deselect every technician in the filter
custom_steps_separated.expected: The chart and the technician table are both hidden; the filter stays visible and reads no technicians

custom_steps_separated.content: Select every technician again in the filter
custom_steps_separated.expected:
The chart settles again and the technician table returns, listing both seeded technicians

The Technician Efficiency chart's Technician filter offers the same technicians as its table, including non-billable ones; unticking one narrows the filter and the table to the selection without changing the options offered, and deselecting everyone hides the chart and the table until a technician is selected again
